entry.name: Neural Networks: Zero to Hero
entry.note: From backprop by hand to a working GPT, on video, building everything live
entry.audience: Engineers who want to build GPT from scratch

covers: torch.Tensor and efficient neural network evaluation
language modeling framework: training, sampling, loss evaluation
machine learning basics: training, learning rate tuning, hyperparameters, evaluation, train/dev/test splits, under/overfitting
reading.format: Video lectures with implementation from scratch.
reading.summary: This course teaches how to build neural networks for language modeling, starting with a bigram character-level model and progressing to a multilayer perceptron and the tokenizer used in GPT models. Finishing it shows practical ability to implement and train language models from scratch and understand tokenization issues in large language models.
